title: Quanta Services to Participate in Institutional Investor Conferences in November and December
summary: Baird Global Industrial Conference UBS Global Industrials & Transportation Conference HOUSTON, Nov. 10, 2026…...
body_markdown:
*Baird Global Industrial Conference* *UBS Global Industrials & Transportation Conference*


HOUSTON


, Nov. 10, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Quanta Services, Inc. (NYSE: PWR) announced today that company management will participate in institutional investor conferences in November and December, including the Baird Global Industrial Conference and the UBS Global Industrials & Transportation Conference.


***Baird 2026 Global Industrial Conference*** Duke Austin, Chief Executive Officer, Jayshree Desai, Chief Financial Officer, and Kip Rupp, Vice President – Investor Relations, will meet with institutional investors during the conference on November 11, 2026, in Chicago. Mr. Austin and Ms. Desai will also participate in a fireside chat hosted by Baird analyst Justin Hauke on the same day at 5:05 p.m. Eastern time, which will be broadcast live over the Internet. Live webcast links and archived replays of this presentation will be available in the "News & Events" area of the Investor Relations section of Quanta's website ([https://investors.quantaservices.com/news-events](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4818550-1&h=1615680918&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.quantaservices.com%2Fnews-events&a=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.quantaservices.com%2Fnews-events) ).


***UBS Global Industrials & Transportation Conference*** Duke Austin, Chief Executive Officer, Jayshree Desai, Chief Financial Officer, and Kip Rupp, Vice President – Investor Relations, will meet with institutional investors during the conference on December 2, 2026, in Palm Beach. Mr. Austin and Ms. Desai will also participate in a fireside chat hosted by UBS analyst Steven Fisher on the same day at 8:50 a.m. Eastern time, which will be broadcast live over the Internet. Live webcast links and archived replays of this presentation will be available in the "News & Events" area of the Investor Relations section of Quanta's website ([https://investors.quantaservices.com/news-events](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4818550-1&h=1615680918&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.quantaservices.com%2Fnews-events&a=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.quantaservices.com%2Fnews-events) ).


**About Quanta Services** Quanta Services is an industry leader in providing specialized infrastructure solutions to the utility, power generation, load center, communications, pipeline, and energy industries. Quanta's comprehensive services include designing, installing, repairing and maintaining energy, load center and communications infrastructure. With operations throughout the United States, Canada, Australia and select other international markets, Quanta has the manpower, resources and expertise to safely complete projects that are local, regional, national or international in scope. For more information, visit[www.quantaservices.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4818550-1&h=219078851&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.quantaservices.com%2F&a=www.quantaservices.com) .
